title: Holiday Plan
intro: Decide the hard parts now, while things are calm, so nobody has to improvise at the door or at the table.
privacy: Saved in protected storage on this device for your signed-in account. What you write stays on this phone unless you share it.
coreMessage: Most holiday blowups aren't about the turkey. They're about a decision nobody made ahead of time.
coreSupport: Write down who is coming, on what terms, and what happens if those terms break. Then everyone hosting follows the same plan, and no one has to decide in the moment.
readyBody: Share it with everyone hosting, so the plan is the same in every room. Keep it open on the day.
notReadyBody: A plan you write the night before gets made under pressure. Choose the invitation, answer each question, and confirm each agreement.
lastSeasonBody: This plan is from last year's holidays. Read it over and change anything that's different this time, or keep it as it is.
loadErrorTitle: Protected plan could not be opened
loadErrorBody: Editing is blocked so an unreadable saved plan cannot be overwritten.
saveError: Not saved. Retry before relying on this plan.
clearBody: This permanently removes the saved plan from protected storage on this device.
gatheringHint: Keep each answer to one or two sentences.
invitationHint: Choose one. "We'll see" usually means deciding at the door.

invited.label: Invited, on terms
invited.termsPlaceholder: Example: You're welcome if you come sober. If you've been using, we'll see you another day.

separateVisit.label: A separate, shorter visit
separateVisit.termsPlaceholder: Example: Breakfast with Mom and me Thursday morning, 9 to 10, at the diner.

notThisYear.label: Not this year
notThisYear.termsPlaceholder: Example: A call Thursday morning and a plate dropped off Friday.

fields.occasionPlaceholder: Example: Thanksgiving dinner at my sister's, 3 PM
fields.ifTermsBreak: If they arrive using, or show up uninvited
fields.ifTermsBreakPlaceholder: Who says it, what they say, and where they go. Example: Dad walks them outside and calls them a ride: "We love you. Today isn't the day. Call me tomorrow." If they've been using, they don't drive.
fields.relatives: What you'll say to relatives who ask
fields.relativesPlaceholder: Example: "We're working through some things as a family. We're not getting into it today, but thank you for caring."
fields.ownExit: Your own way to step away
fields.ownExitPlaceholder: Example: I drive myself so I can leave at 6, and I can step outside to call my sister.
fields.kidsPlaceholder: Who stays with them, and what they'll be told in words their age.
fields.giftPlaceholder: Example: a warm coat, a framed photo, a meal together. Skip cash and gift cards that work like cash.

commitmentHint: Confirm each one with everyone hosting.

commitments.hostsAgree: Everyone hosting has seen this plan and agrees to it.
commitments.noCash: No cash or cash-like gifts (gift cards, prepaid cards), before, during, or after.
commitments.secureAlcoholMeds: Alcohol and prescription medications are put away or locked up.
commitments.noTableDebate: No treatment debate at the table. If it needs saying, it gets said privately, another day.
commitments.followPlan: If they arrive using, we follow this plan instead of improvising.
commitments.safetyFirst: If they've been using, they don't drive. If they try to drive, won't leave, or get aggressive, we call 911, and nobody wrestles for keys.
commitments.medicalEmergency: If they can't stay awake, are hard to wake, or are breathing slowly, it's a medical emergency: we call 911, give naloxone if opioids could be involved, and stay with them.
commitments.naloxone: If opioids could be involved, naloxone is in the house and two people know where it is.
commitments.supportCall: I've told one person I'll call them before and after.
commitments.ownDay: Their choices don't get to cancel the day for everyone else. I'll enjoy part of it.

shareNote: Sharing sends your answers as a message, except your own way to step away, with one line at the end about the free app. Once sent, it's no longer only on this device.
shareFooter: Written with Sober Helpline, a free app for families who love someone with an addiction: {{url}}
shareCopied: Plan copied. Paste it into a message.
shareError: We couldn't share the plan. Please try again.
footer: Warmth and limits belong at the same table. A plan doesn't make the day cold. It keeps one person's choices from deciding it for everyone.

todayCard.titleNew: Decide the hard parts before the holidays
todayCard.body: Who's invited, on what terms, and what happens if they show up using. Ten minutes now saves the day.
